preconditions.TARGET_ASSESSMENT: Confirmed canonical target; required resources/capability accepted; no implied placement passes.
preconditions.PREREQUISITE_CHECK: Declared relevant edge, current observations and retained parent frame.
preconditions.GUIDED_REPAIR: Supported repair point or explicit bounded instructional trial; no fabricated cause.
preconditions.INDEPENDENT_CHECK: Fresh accepted item and faded support; independent eligibility checked by host.
preconditions.RETURN_TO_TARGET: Retained frame; relevant immediate repair criterion or evidence-supported resumption; parent is retested.
preconditions.TRANSFER_CHECK: Original target declared immediate criterion satisfied; required components included.
preconditions.REVIEW_CHECK: Explicit trusted review event, retained evidence and actual timing.
preconditions.SESSION_CLOSED: Accepted partial/full report; no pending provider can reopen.

trigger_edges.condition: The learner is stuck at the smallest guided question, and the skill that step exercises is a declared prerequisite of the current repair skill and available in this deployment. Host-only; a model proposal cannot use this edge.
trigger_edges.source: Conductor Round 2, ruling 8 (runtime copy only; the package policy is unchanged)
